protocol: Sequential isolated workers; setup and capture separate; synchronized wall median; every sample validated in original equations. GPU output conversion is outside timed solves. Acceptance is numerical; device_only_graph is reported separately. Start spaces differ by algorithm. Failed timings are diagnostics only.

cases.notes: Standard first-order linearization of uniformly damped coupled oscillators; right modes
cases.start: Reference seed 2026; restored per trial (algorithms have different start spaces)
cases.reason: No native CuPy generalized shift/buckling or general eigs path in this adapter; do not apply Euclidean eigsh to M^-1 K

process_acceptance_policy: Every requested row must pass its recorded physical and stopping gates; unsupported/error/timeout rows are rejected. Diagnostic mode preserves these failures without failing the numerical process gate. Graph, timing and baseline-regression results remain separate.
